name: Civil unrest
summary: Nationwide strike in France on 5 Nov with largely peaceful marches; 70,000 police deployed
state: Workers struck across France on 5 Nov, with hundreds of thousands expected to march over living costs and the budget (Al Jazeera; CNN). Marches were largely peaceful, and about 270,000 marched outside Paris by union counts (ThePrint; Rio Times). The government deployed about 70,000 police. No deaths have been reported, so the Alert line is not crossed.
for_you: Travellers to France should expect transport disruption on strike days and follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Significant protests, no deadly nationwide unrest = Watch

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Workers strike across France
ThePrint — Largely peaceful marches across France as workers strike

why: Mass protest and state crackdowns signal political fragility and can topple governments.
drivers: Cost of living, elections, corruption, repression, food and fuel prices.

rubric.alert: Deadly nationwide unrest or a state crackdown in a major country.
rubric.watch: Significant protests in several countries or deadly unrest in one.
rubric.normal: No deadly mass unrest in large countries.
